The team's head coach was [[Matt McMahon (basketball)|Matt McMahon]], in his second season at LSU. The Tigers played their home games at [[Pete Maravich Assembly Center]] in [[Baton Rouge, Louisiana]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 LSU Tigers basketball team|Tigers]] finished the season 13–18, 2–16 in [[2022–23 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC Play]] to finish in last place, despite starting the season with an impressive 12–1 run. As the 14th seed in the [[2023 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], the Tigers defeated [[2022–23 Georgia Bulldogs basketball team|Georgia]] in the first round before falling to [[2022–23 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]] in the second round.
